findings.summary: Some LOD chunks fail to generate or appear missing, creating gaps in the distant terrain. The LodQuadTree tracks missing positions and queues them for generation, but some may never complete.
findings.root_cause: LodQuadTree.missingGenerationPosSet tracks positions that need generation, but the generation queue may fail or timeout. The queuedGenerationPosSet tracks in-progress generations, but failed generations may not be re-queued properly.
evidence: LodQuadTree.java:124: missingGenerationPosSet for tracking missing chunks
LodQuadTree.java:742-765: Generation queuing and completion handling
LodQuadTree.java:754-755: On exception, adds back to missing set

primary.issue: Failed generations may not be re-queued correctly

gap_analysis.current_behavior: Some LOD chunks never generate, leaving gaps
gap_analysis.required_behavior: All visible chunks should have LODs generated

proposed_fix.approach: Add retry logic and better error handling for failed generations
implementation_steps: 1. Add retry counter for failed generations

falsification_test.description: If gaps persist after retry logic, issue is in generation itself
steps: 3. If specific positions always fail, check generation code

confidence_reason: Generation failure handling could be improved, but root cause may vary
